newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wallace Computer cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wallace Computer cut.

text.p: --Jefferies & Co cut its rating on Wallace Computer to accumulate from buy following a company statement on Thursday that it would not meet analysts' expectations for the third quarter.
--cut earnings estimates for fiscal 1997 to $1.85 a share from $2.02 a share and for fiscal 1998 to $2.05 a share from $2.27 a share.
--said that despite the lower short term outlook Wallace is positioned for long term success.
--shares of Wallace were 1-1/8 higher at 26-3/4 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
